integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses the source's Theorem A and coefficient normalization together with standard strictly-singular ideal facts. No numerical experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The inequalities are lower bounds only. Sharpness and sufficiency of coefficient vanishing for compactness or strict singularity are not proved; an abstract version of the generic factorization-to-ideal estimate could exist under other terminology.
title: Ultrafilter diagonal coefficients bound strictly singular and essential distances
